material_upgrades.detail: Official Downloads API explicitly supports area=TQ; all three prepared target tiles TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 share this 100km square, so one TQ-area download root can feed all three.
Current technical specification confirms 200x200 cells, 50m pixel size, north-west row origin/presentation, pixel-centre values and 0.1m height precision.
Current official product supply states no-registration online download and 10km tiles arranged under 100km grid folders.
Current runtime DNS resolution for api.os.uk failed; no archive bytes/hash observed. Not classified as NO_DATA.
